podcast.title: Arrangement for Billy Ward and the Dominoes
podcast.body: Hall had recently arranged a version of "Stardust" for Billy Ward and the Dominoes, and Art Rupe believed his arrangement for Sam Cooke's "Summertime" carried a similar musical feel. "The Billy Ward reference was because Rene Hall had recently arranged a version of Stardust for the dominoes."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode Sixty: "You Send Me" by Sam Cooke

podcast.title: Instrumental Arranger for "You Send Me"
podcast.body: Rene Hall, a guitarist from New Orleans who had recently left Billy Ward and the Dominoes, served as the instrumental arranger for Sam Cooke's "You Send Me" recording session. "Along with Cliff White on guitar, there was Vennay Hall, a guitarist from New Orleans who had recently quit Billy Ward and the Dominoes, and acted as instrumental arranger."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode Sixty: "You Send Me" by Sam Cooke

podcast.title: Overdubbed "I'll Come Running Back to You"
podcast.body: After Sam Cooke's legal dispute with Art Rupe, Hall was hired by Rupe to overdub Sam's demo of "I'll Come Running Back to You" with The Lee Gotch Singers, to make it sound like "You Send Me." "Roup...got many hall and the Lee got singers...to record overdubbs, to make it sound as much like You Send Me as possible."
